cautions: 1985 corporate operating history is not proof of the legacy logo introduction date.
The 2011 REBRAND award is not the launch of the lowercase identity.
Monochrome, reversed, stacked, and tagline variants are not automatically new chronological eras.
A report cover is evidence of use, not a universal first or last appearance.
The red/orange/green palette in a 2022 report does not strictly exclude concurrent use of a refreshed palette elsewhere.
User screenshot capture timestamps do not date the photographed sign or logo.
This is an evidence-based reference sheet, not an exhaustive corporate brand archive.
